chunks: Al-Bazanti asked Abū al-Ḥasan al-Riḍā عليه السلام, saying to him: “May Allah rectify your affairs, how is the procedure of liʿān?”
He said: “The Imam sits and places his back toward the qiblah, and places the man on his right, and the woman and the child on his left.”

key_terms.الرَّجُلَ: the man involved in the liʿān proceeding
key_terms.الصَّبِيَّ: the child mentioned as part of the procedural arrangement
key_terms.الْإِمَامُ: the presiding Imam or authority conducting the proceeding
key_terms.الْقِبْلَةِ: the direction of prayer used here as a point of orientation
key_terms.الْمَرْأَةَ: the woman involved in the liʿān proceeding
key_terms.الْمُلَاعَنَةُ: liʿān, the legal procedure of mutual cursing between spouses

ai.seo_question: How is the procedure of liʿān arranged according to Imam al-Riḍā عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith describes the procedural arrangement for al-mulāʿanah (mutual cursing) as explained by Imam al-Riḍā عليه السلام. It gives a legal description of how the Imam, the man, the woman, and the child are positioned during the proceeding.
